problem.title: Find the Longest Decreasing Root-to-Leaf Path
problem.problemStatement: Given a binary tree whose nodes contain integer values, determine the longest root-to-leaf path whose values are strictly decreasing.
problem.input: • The first line contains an integer N. • The second line contains the node values. • The next N lines describe the binary tree.
problem.output: • Print the nodes of the longest decreasing path.
